info.title: Zouriel Workflows REST API
info.description: The API every engine serves under its mount point (MapWorkflowApi in .NET). Exported from the .NET sample app (GET /openapi/v1.json); paths are shown mounted at /api/workflows. Request and response bodies for definitions, registries and settings follow spec/schema/*.json.

get.description: What a reset would take back (spec §6): the reset option and the items, oldest first, with a `token`. Item kinds: `created`, `field`, `action`, `message`, `webhook`, `move` (another record moved by applyTransition; never undoable). 403 `notAllowed` when the caller is not among the lifecycle's reset `who` or there is nothing to reset.

post.description: Starts the record's workflow over (spec §6). `undo` lists item ids to take back; `token` (from GET) makes the reset fail with 409 `resetChanged` when the list has changed since it was opened, as does an id no longer listed. 400 `notUndoable` for an item that cannot be taken back, `invalidInput` for the form. Writes that take things back start no automations.

tenant.description: The chain it belongs to, or null without tenancy.

actorId.description: The user id, or the instance id for workflows.

actorName.description: The actor's display name (workflow key for workflows).

entity.description: The record's entity, when it concerns a record.

before.description: Masked JSON of the state before.

after.description: Masked JSON of the state after.

correlationId.description: Groups entries of one chain of work.

causationId.description: The instance or entry that caused this one, if known.

prevHash.description: The previous entry's hash (64 zeros for the first).

oneOf.description: The latest published version's JSON, or null.

versions.description: Published versions, newest first, with instance counts.

DefinitionDetail.description: A definition with its draft, latest published version, version history and the draft's lint problems.

key.description: Its key (unique; other workflows and the API use it).

entity.description: The record type it is about, if any.

version.description: The latest published version (0 when never published).

hasDraftChanges.description: True when the draft differs from the latest published version.

updatedAt.description: When the draft or status last changed.

runningInstances.description: Unfinished automation and record instances of any version.

DefinitionSummary.description: A workflow definition in lists (builder home page, API).

instances.description: How many automation and record instances are pinned to it.

DefinitionVersionInfo.description: One published version of a definition.

to.description: The user id to hand the task to.

state.description: The state key to move to.

lifecycle.description: Which lifecycle, when the entity has more than one.
Which lifecycle, when the entity has more than one.

code.description: Stable problem code, the same in every engine and editor (`spec/fixtures/lint`).

node.description: The id of the step, state or transition the problem is on; null for the whole definition.

message.description: What is wrong, in plain words.

LintProblem.description: One problem in a definition. `Node` is the id of the step, state or transition it is on.

stateMap.description: Old state key → new state key, where keys differ.

node.description: A transition id, `reset`, `trigger` (a manual start) or an approval/task step id.

who.description:
The assignees (roles, groups, users, person fields of the record) who may do it. What empty means depends on
the node: a transition or the reset, nobody by hand; a manual start (`trigger`), anyone who can see the
record; an approval or task, refused (it needs someone, `lintErrors`).

PermissionChange.description: One permission change: who may do a node of a workflow.

note.description: What changed, shown in the version list (default "Permissions changed").

changed.description: False when the changes left everything as it was (no version was published).

draftSkipped.description: The nodes the draft no longer has, so the draft did not get their change.

recordsMoved.description: Lifecycles: how many record instances moved from earlier versions to the new one.

key.description: Its key (unique; other workflows and the API use it).

entity.description: The record type it is about, if any.

version.description: The latest published version (0 when never published).

hasDraftChanges.description: True when the draft differs from the latest published version.

updatedAt.description: When the draft or status last changed.

runningInstances.description: Unfinished automation and record instances of any version.

PermissionsSummary.description: What `POST /definitions/{id}/permissions` did: the definition's summary plus the outcome of the change.

note.description: What changed, shown in the version list.

ReasonBody.description: A body carrying only a reason (e.g. cancelling an instance).

input.description: The reset form's answers, if it has a form.

lifecycle.description: Which lifecycle, when the record has more than one.

undo.description: The reset list's item ids to take back (from `GET …/reset`); empty = none.

token.description: The reset list's token (from `GET …/reset`); when the list has changed since, the reset fails with `resetChanged`.

comment.description: The person's remarks: required when the reset's `comment` is `required` (`commentRequired`), ignored when `none`; at most 2000 characters.

id.description: Stable id to send back in the reset's `undo` list.

kind.description: `field` (a field it changed), `created` (a record it created), `action`, `message`, `webhook` or `move` (another record moved by `applyTransition`, never undoable).

title.description: What it was, in words ("Reviewer of Application “Bursary”: back to nobody").

detail.description: More about it (the value now, what created it), if any.

undoable.description: Whether the reset can take it back (messages, webhooks and actions without an undo cannot).

selected.description: Whether it is ticked by default (not when it was changed again since, or cannot be undone).

warning.description: Why it is unticked or cannot be undone, if so.

ResetItem.description: One thing a workflow did that the reset list shows (spec §6 reset).

label.description: The button label ("Reset workflow" by default).

to.description: The state key it goes back to.

confirm.description: A confirmation question to ask first, if set.

oneOf.description: The form to fill in (e.g. a reason), if the reset asks for one.

comment.description: Whether the person is asked for remarks: `none`, `optional` or `required` (resolved, never null).

ResetOption.description: Starting the record's workflow over, offered to the people the lifecycle's reset allows (spec §6).

reset.description: The reset as offered to the viewer.

items.description: What the record's workflows did since it last started over, oldest first.

token.description:
Fingerprint of the items and the values they would restore. Send it back with the reset: when the list has
changed since (someone edited a field it would restore), the reset fails with `resetChanged`.

ResetPreview.description: What a reset would do: its option (label, target, form) and the workflow's work it can take back.

target.description: Which incident, by token id or failed step id, when several paths stopped (default: the first).

entity.description: The record's entity, if the signal is about one.

outputs.description: Outputs to give the skipped step.

target.description: Which incident, by token id or failed step id, when several paths stopped (default: the first).

lifecycle.description: Which lifecycle, when the entity has more than one.

comment.description: The person's remarks: required when the transition's `comment` is `required` (`commentRequired`), ignored when `none`; at most 2000 characters.

type.description: The trigger type (spec §5), or `lifecycle` for an owned field.

entity.description: The record type it watches, if any.

field.description: The field it watches or owns, if any.

summary.description: A plain-English description ("When Application Stage changes to Done").

version.description: The published version the trigger comes from.

TriggerOverview.description: One active trigger or lifecycle, for the "Watching" section of global settings.

oneOf.description: Extra data: lint problems for `lintErrors`, field errors for `invalidInput`.

WorkflowError.description: The body of every error response: a stable code (spec), a message for people, and details (lint problems, form errors…).
